title: Elite: Oath Is Not Bait
description: Thunder Gate Covenant: Oath Is Not Bait unfolds across high storm gate dais of rune-iron ribs, cracked oath monoliths, hanging war chains, and cloudlit abyss edges, pushing the 5-Titan Asgardian Titan to convert endurance into decisive counterpressure.
lore: Oath Is Not Bait advances the Storm-Oath Covenant arc: the Gate tries to harvest Asgardian vows, while Valhalla law insists courage must remain chosen responsibility.
terrain: high storm gate dais of rune-iron ribs, cracked oath monoliths, hanging war chains, and cloudlit abyss edges

objectives.primary: Bind the Thunder Gate covenant and survive the counterpulse. Elite remix: complete it while a secondary storm condition is active.
optional: Trigger at least three Oathbound counterattacks
Hold every objective for one full enemy turn

boss.notes: Boss pressure tied to banner command and broken-oath memory.

specialRules: Covenant Stand: the Titan can bind damage together, but poor spacing turns shared courage into shared risk.
Oathbound: surviving damage strengthens the next committed strike.
Elite Storm: lightning collapse advances one turn earlier.
Elite Banner Law: enemy buffs persist until objective action breaks the source.
victoryConditions: Bind the Thunder Gate covenant and survive the counterpulse. Elite remix: complete it while a secondary storm condition is active.

stars.one: Primary completed under severe casualty or turn pressure

squadDesignNotes: Balanced for the standard 5-Titan Titan; special future modes may override team size explicitly.
meaningfulDifferences: Boss or elite wave uses altered entry timing

tacticalProfile.rule: Recommended advantages only — any valid active Titan can attempt the mission.
